एध् {c1c} A. (एधते, एधांचक्रे, ऐधिष्ट, ए
धितुं, एधित)
1 To grow, increase;
विनापि संगमं स्त्रीणां कवीनां सुखमेधते

.
--2 To prosper, become happy,
live in comfort. द्वावेतौ सुखमेधेते

.
--3 To grow strong, become
great.
--4 To extend.
--5 To swell,
rise. --Caus. To cause to grow or
increase; to greet, celebrate,
honour; नैदिधः स्वपराक्रमं
